You press your palm against the stone and patiently coax a different shape from it.

Rules

Action
Main Action
Attribute
Knowledge
Time
Ten minutes per attempt.
Target / range / shape
One adjacent ordinary stone obstruction; ten minutes.
Duration
The result applies when the stated activity is complete; information and earned progress persist.
Equipment / acquisition
No item needed unless named above.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic

Persuade a small part of the stone to soften. Create passage progress toward a target stated by the DA; no instant destruction of a building.

Weak
1 progress.
Standard
2 progress.
Strong
3 progress and identify whether continuing would endanger the structure.
